Name: Benaiah, Ancestor of Jahaziel
Role: Levite of the Sons of Asaph
Summary: Benaiah, son of Jeiel, was an ancestor of Jahaziel, father of Zechariah in the line of Asaph's singers.
KeyStory: Benaiah stands in Jahaziel's line: son of Jeiel, father of Zechariah.
RelatedPeople: Jahaziel, Son of Zechariah; Zechariah, Father of Jahaziel
LifeLesson: A singer's family line carried the praise that met an invading army.
